query.title: Fix login token regression
query.description: Production auth retry failed after changing token refresh

ledger:
## M-001: Auth Token Refresh Regression

Date: 2026-05-16
Affected Area: auth
Signature Keywords: auth, login, token, refresh, regression
Signature Paths: apps/api/src/auth/token.ts
Risk Tags: auth, security, verification

### Actual Root Cause

- Token refresh tests did not cover expired-session retry.

### Prevention

- Add regression coverage before changing auth token flows.

Status: Encoded In Test
